reference: Your speed test looks fast; why does the video call freeze? Calls send a steady stream of small packets, timed evenly. Missing ones are packet loss: the picture freezes or skips. Uneven arrivals are jitter: the app must wait and buffer. Call networks target at most one lost packet per thousand, and jitter within fifty milliseconds. Bandwidth and latency can look fine; check loss and jitter too. Download Meshline for nearby messaging, even offline.
